prompt:
No host, no woman, no Victoria, no presenter portrait. Без лица ведущей. Животные, объекты и типографика.
Master 3:4 @ 4K, сетка 3x3 из 9 панелей 3:4, row-major 01–09.
Стиль: animals_viktoria_collage. Графит #111111–#1a1a1a, маджента #ff006e, белый #ffffff, золото.
Сетка: slice_method seam, тонкие белые желоба (thin white gutters) на 1/3 и 2/3. Отступы ≥12% от линий реза и краёв. Текст не у нижнего края.
Типографика: verbatim-текст, без лишних надписей, без подписи Victoria. Крупный белый гротеск, рукописный маджента.

Панели 01–09:
01 (hook): "Monday: \"this week\". Wednesday. No day." Кот, calendar-without-a-day, маджента-скотч, телефон экраном вниз.
02 (pain): "Thursday and Friday nights are frozen" / "The week is half gone. Evenings sit on hold. You decline other plans because his \"this week\" is taking up space." Пёс, пустые фишки.
03 (mistake): "The mistake: waiting for a last-minute ping" / "You tell yourself he is busy and will reach out last minute. You hand your calendar to someone who never opened his." Пёс.
04 (mechanism): "\"This week\" books you with zero cost" / "He gets the credit of showing interest. You get the wait. Cancelling costs him nothing: no day was set." Кот, карточка брони.
05 (decoder): "What he says vs what it means" / "\"Let's catch up this week\" → you hear \"he misses me\" → reality: keeping you warm at zero cost. \"I'll text closer to the weekend\" → you hear \"he's flexible\" → reality: you are option B if nothing better appears." Сова.
06 (checklist): "3 signs of a real invitation" / "1) A specific day is named. 2) A time or place is proposed. 3) He asks if it fits your schedule. Anything else is placeholder noise." Сова.
07 (rule): "No day by evening — week is yours" / "If there is no day and time by Wednesday evening, your week is closed to him. Make plans without waiting for a ping." Кот.
08 (recap): "He books your time, not your anxiety" / "Someone who wants to see you puts a slot on the calendar. Someone who does not holds your week as a question mark." Сова.
09 (cta): "Comment SLOT" / "Audio reading in my app. Essence–Shadow–Vector." Рукописный "SLOT" маджента, кофе, телефон экраном вниз, маджента-скотч, карточка брони.

Избегать: host portrait, woman face, female presenter, Victoria portrait, Victoria face, Alena, human model, foreign faces, sticker halo, die-cut, white outline around animals, cutout, zero-gutter touching cells, horizontal strip, 2x3 grid, sheet clothes, white cami, ivory blazer, jeans, platinum hair, white-blonde hair, skulls, blood, dripping candles, ouija, horror, blurry, low resolution, duplicate text, extra slogans, watermark, Portuguese text, bot spreads, Academy

gutter_cleanup.method: near-white pixels on exact cut-lines; no crop, no resize

edge_cleanup.method: copy interior pixels over outer edge strips after slice; no crop, no resize
